final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Alert points at shippingservice: LATENCY_DEGRADATION p90 4.01ms -> 2019.74ms (+50267.6%), with frontend ERROR_SPIKE 100%->71.8% and frontend logs 'failed to get shipping quote: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = no healthy upstream' on /cart (HTTP 500), so the victim is the leaf service shippingservice. Object layer shows the only outlier pod shippingservice-7b5c459cdd-hlf6v (1/2 READY, CrashLoopBackOff, restarts=3, node worker-01) while all other 10 boutique services are 2/2 Running with 0 restarts; DescribeResource gives Last State Terminated / Reason OOMKilled / Exit Code 137, restarts every ~19s, Namespace events show 'Warning BackOff Back-off restarting failed container server' for that pod and 'Readiness probe failed ... connection refused/503' for its predecessors, and the Deployment reports MinimumReplicasUnavailable. Closing on the code surface (custom image wangyl2128/shippingservice-v2:latest): quote.go CreateQuoteFromCount loops 10 times per GetQuote call doing os.Open("/src/log.csv") + csv.ReadAll(), i.e. excessive file reads (and full-file parsing into memory) on every shipping-quote request - the upstream implementation contains no file I/O. This single code defect explains both the ~500x p90 latency degradation and the memory blow-up that OOMKills the 128Mi-limited container, making the Service unavailable ('no healthy upstream').

        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m

          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
